label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Hablen a toda congregación de Israel, diciendo: En el diez a este mes, y tomen para ellos varón cordero a casa de padres, cordero a la casa.
spanish: Hablen a toda congregación de Israel, diciendo: En el diez a este mes, y tomarán para ellos, cada uno, una res del rebaño a casa de padres, una res del rebaño a la casa.
grammarChanges: Changed 'tomen' to 'tomarán' so the qal imperfect 3mp subject (they) stays distinct from the 2mp imperative addressees of 'Hablen'; the mood stays indicative, not imperative.
Replaced 'varón' with the distributive 'cada uno' to carry אִישׁ's distributive sense rather than marking male gender or qualifying the animal.
Replaced both occurrences of 'cordero' with 'res del rebaño' to keep שֶׂה as one flock animal of open age (sheep or goat) rather than narrowing it to a young lamb.
readerNote: Chose 'cada uno' for the distributive אִישׁ instead of gender-marking 'varón', and 'res del rebaño' for both שֶׂה tokens to leave species and age open rather than narrowing to a lamb.
